title: Health
description: Talk about symptoms, body parts, and medical visits.
guidebook:
### Talking About Symptoms

In Portuguese, physical conditions are often expressed using **estar com** (literally, "to be with") rather than simply "to have":
- *Estou com febre.* (I have a fever.)
- *Estou com dor de cabeça.* (I have a headache.)

### Describing How You Feel

For temporary states of health, use the verb **estar** combined with an adjective. Remember to match the ending to your gender:
- *Eu estou cansado.* (I am tired. — masculine)
- *Eu estou cansada.* (I am tired. — feminine)
- *Ela está doente.* (She is sick.)

### Expressing Pain

To say a specific body part hurts, use the verb **doer** (to hurt):
- *O meu pé dói.* (My foot hurts.)
- *As minhas mãos doem.* (My hands hurt.)
